params.body:
`hand.mjs policy` says when the waiting draft only adds reversible actions (Elixir marked it `repairOnly`): it can then be approved with the passkey on Portal's Grants page, as well as signed on the token. README updated.

`node --check hand.mjs` passes. `node --test` fails one test, `the draft and the version go through Portal's doors` (`r.json is not a function`), the same way on main; this change does not touch it.

Companion PRs: control, elixir, portal (`workbench/repair-signer`).
params.title: hand.mjs policy: say when a draft can be approved by passkey
